who: Real stack · real mail server · local stand-in for the accounting system
title: Bank statement in, invoices settled, reminders only where due
sub: CAMT.053 and CSV statements matched to open invoices with explained scores, booked in accounting when sure, the rest reviewed by a person.
outro: Python · FastAPI · SQLite · CAMT.053 · defusedxml · accounting API · SMTP · Docker · e2e in GitHub Actions.

caps.text: This morning's bank statement as CAMT.053, the XML format German and EU banks export
9 bookings read. 6 payments matched and booked on their own, through a short outage of the accounting API
Every match says why: a discount taken, a bank fee kept, two invoices in one transfer, a part payment
The bank's CSV export overlaps the CAMT file. The same bookings aren't imported twice
Two payments weren't clear enough. €560 from a private name fits two invoices equally
A person picks the right one. The marketplace payout isn't an invoice payment at all
Reminders go only to customers who really owe money, for what's still open
